title: aspidium volubile var. cavernicola
intro: Aspidium volubile var. cavernicola, commonly known as the cavernicola fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, likely due to its therapeutic actions of expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium volubile var. cavernicola include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
